audit.whatIsWrong: The early lane is written as Lucian out-ranging Galio ('his range and double-shot keep the chip even while you farm from the back').
audit.why: Piercing Light is 500 range and his autos are 500. Winds of War casts at 825. Only Ardent Blaze (900) and The Culling (1400) reach further, and neither is his lane chip. Galio out-ranges the poke he actually uses.
audit.corrected: Level 1-2 is still Lucian's on burst, but the reason is the double-shot, not reach — the 825-vs-500 gap is now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings call Hero's Entrance global ('global engage', 'global roam', 'R to a flagged ally').
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140 with range 4000/4750/5500 and must be cast onto an ALLY. It is long-range, not global.
audit.corrected: Level-6 spike restated as landing on an ally up to 4000 units away.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer mentions that Galio's own crowd control powers Lucian's passive.
audit.why: Riot on Lightslinger: 'when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.' Justice Punch's knockup, Shield of Durand's taunt and Hero's Entrance all immobilise, so every lock Galio lands arms two empowered autos.
audit.corrected: Sequence it: E-punch for the knockup, charge Shield of Durand so the reduction absorbs the two empowered autos, release the taunt. Written into early, mid, spikes[1], whys[2], report[5] and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: Relentless Pursuit is described only as 'his dash + reset' with no number, and the page is built entirely around its cooldown.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14 — one of the longest dash cooldowns in the game at rank 1 — and Riot's text says 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.' Denying double-shots is what keeps it down.
audit.corrected: Real number plus the reduction mechanic written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, spikes[0] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The loading line ends 'Anti-heal if he sustains'.
audit.why: The kit derives a heal flag on Lightslinger, but Riot's text is 'When Lucian is HEALED or shielded by an ALLY' — a trigger condition, not self-sustain. Lucian has no healing of his own in the kit, so the anti-heal cue is filler.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the Lightslinger arming rule.

edits.before: Lucian's biggest window: a Q-into-Lightslinger combo (ability proc making his next auto double-shot) chunks you through minions before your W taunt and E dash exist — give ground and farm from max range.
edits.after: Lucian's biggest window: Piercing Light is only 500 range, but Lightslinger makes his next auto a double-shot, and every one that lands ticks his 16-second Relentless Pursuit down — deny them and his escape stays gone.

edits.before: Your first kill window: drop Q's tornado on him, E (Justice Punch) in for the knockup, then start W and taunt on its release — his one Relentless Pursuit charge can't dodge the knockup and the taunt.
edits.after: Your first kill window, and the order matters: E-punch for the knockup, which arms two empowered Lightslinger autos, then charge Shield of Durand so the reduction eats them and release the taunt into his spent dash.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance flips the lane: even behind, you R to a flagged ally on the sidelane or a jungle skirmish and snowball a map he has no way to contest.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance flips the lane: even behind, you land on an ally up to 4000 units away — a sidelane or a jungle skirmish he has no way to contest.

edits.before: Survive the level 1-2 Q-Lightslinger chip, then land E-knockup into W-taunt so his Relentless Pursuit dash can't slip the lock
edits.after: E-knockup first, then charge W — the knockup arms two empowered Lightslinger autos and the charge is what absorbs them

edits.before: Hit 6 and use Hero's Entrance to roam — your global engage beats his lane-locked range
edits.after: Hit 6 and Hero's Entrance onto an ally up to 4000 away — he cannot contest the map

edits.before: Dodge your E knockup with Relentless Pursuit, then re-poke from outside taunt range
edits.after: Land double-shots to tick Relentless Pursuit's 16s cooldown down before he punches

edits.before: Lucian owns the very first levels — a Q (Piercing Light) into his Lightslinger double-shot chips you while you only have Winds of War and no way to close, so don't walk up to last-hit into that combo. Drop your Q tornado on his side of the wave to zone him and farm from the back. At Level 3 the lane flips: with W and E both online, you E-punch in for the knockup, taunt on Shield of Durand's release, and his single Relentless Pursuit charge can't dodge both — that's your first real kill threat.
edits.after: Lucian owns the very first levels — Piercing Light (Q) into his Lightslinger double-shot chips you while you only have Winds of War, so don't walk up to last-hit into that combo. His Q is 500 range against your 825, so zone with the tornado and farm from the back. At Level 3 the lane flips, and the order matters: E-punch for the knockup, which immobilises him and arms two empowered Lightslinger autos, then charge Shield of Durand so the reduction eats them and release the taunt.

edits.before: This is your window. Lucian is paper-thin with no sustain, so any time you E-knockup onto him and taunt him into your tower, he's dead — bait out Relentless Pursuit first, then commit the all-in. At 6, Hero's Entrance changes the matchup entirely: even if he's poked you down in lane, you R onto a flagged ally on a sidelane or a jungle fight, land the knockup and taunt, and snowball a map he can't follow. Don't sit trading autos into his double-shot; force the combo all-in or leave to make plays elsewhere.
edits.after: This is your window. Lucian is paper-thin with no sustain, so any E-knockup into a taunt at your tower kills him — but every immobilise you land arms two empowered Lightslinger autos, so charge Shield of Durand through them rather than standing in them. Relentless Pursuit is 16 seconds at rank 1 and only ticks down when his double-shots connect, so denying the shots keeps his one escape gone. At 6, drop Hero's Entrance on an ally up to 4000 away and snowball a map he cannot follow.

edits.before: Lucian becomes a problem if the game goes long and he gets lifesteal and crit (Galeforce, IE) online — his sustained DPS climbs while your tank-AP damage plateaus, and he can kite the gap between your E and taunt with Relentless Pursuit. Your edge late isn't the 1v1, it's R-engage and front-to-back teamfighting: flank with Hero's Entrance, land the knockup-taunt to lock him, and let your team delete him while he's stunned. Close the map before his crit items make the straight duel unwinnable.
edits.after: Lucian becomes a problem if the game goes long and he gets lifesteal and crit (Galeforce, IE) online — his sustained DPS climbs while your tank-AP damage plateaus, and Relentless Pursuit slips the gap between your punch and the taunt. Your edge late isn't the 1v1, it's R-engage and front-to-back teamfighting: flank onto an ally with Hero's Entrance, land the knockup-taunt to lock him, and let your team delete him — expect his first two autos out of the lock to be empowered.

edits.before: You add a second ability but still lack the full W-E combo; his range and double-shot keep the chip even while you farm from the back.
edits.after: You add a second ability but still lack the full W-E combo; his double-shot keeps the chip even, though your 825 tornado outreaches his 500 Q.

edits.before: With Q-W-E online you E-knockup, taunt on Shield of Durand's release, and his one Relentless Pursuit charge can't escape the lock at your tower.
edits.after: E-knockup arms two empowered Lightslinger autos, so charge Shield of Durand into them and release the taunt — his one dash cannot slip both.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance gives you a global roam and a kill-threat all-in, swinging the map even when the raw lane is close.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance lands on an ally up to 4000 units away, swinging the map even when the raw lane is close.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it’s down. Track it before every punch. - Your W: the trade-flipper — never burn it early. - Your R: a map-wide win condition — spend it on allies' fights.
edits.after: - Relentless Pursuit: 16s at rank 1, 14s maxed — long, but every Lightslinger double-shot that lands ticks it down, so deny the shots. - Piercing Light: 9s at 500 range. - Your W: 18s, never burn it early. - Your R: 180s, onto an ally.

edits.before: Track Lucian's Relentless Pursuit: His dash + reset. Engage when it’s down. When it is down — Q-poke + punch the gap.
edits.after: Every immobilise you land arms Lightslinger: his next two autos hit harder. Charge W into them, then release the taunt.

edits.before: - Galio vs Lucian - Track: Lucian Relentless Pursuit. - Punch only on its cooldown. - W is the trade-flipper, never burn it early. - Shove + R-roam from 6. - Anti-heal if he sustains.
edits.after: - Galio vs Lucian - Your knockup arms his Lightslinger: two empowered autos. - Charge W into them, taunt on release. - Deny double-shots and his 16s dash stays down. - Shove + R-roam from 6.

edits.before: Q-poke + the Colossal Smash empowered auto wins most level-1 exchanges. Identify how Lucian contests the first waves.
edits.after: His Piercing Light plus a Lightslinger double-shot beats anything you own at 1 — concede it and last-hit from the back.

edits.before: His dash + reset. Engage when it’s down. Only punch once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 16s at rank 1, but his landed double-shots tick it down. Deny them, then punch.

edits.before: That is Lucian's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Refuse it — and remember your own knockup hands him two empowered Lightslinger autos.

edits.before: Lucian wins by landing Relentless Pursuit, punishing your E commit, and kiting your short range.
edits.after: Lucian wins by slipping the punch with Relentless Pursuit and cashing the double-shots your CC arms.

notes: The find here is that Galio's own crowd control powers Lucian: Lightslinger gives his next two basic attacks bonus magic damage whenever a nearby enemy champion is IMMOBILIZED, and Justice Punch, Shield of Durand and Hero's Entrance all immobilise. Neither layer said so, and it changes the combo order — the W charge should absorb the two empowered autos the knockup just armed. Second: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 and shortens only when his double-shots land, which turns 'deny the double-shot' from a platitude into the thing that keeps his escape down. FLAG MISFIRE for the record: the kit derives heal, shield and hardCC flags on Lightslinger, but all three come from Riot's TRIGGER clause ('when Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized') — Lucian neither heals nor applies CC through his passive, so I removed the 'anti-heal if he sustains' cue rather than acting on the flag.
